title: own_words misses command words after if/then, !, env, a newline and a nested shell in a chain
goal: bl_land.own_words (BG-zvh7cvyo) reads the command words of a shell -c string after a newline, the reserved words if/then/else/do/while/!, a prefix runner such as env, and a nested sh -c that is not the only command, so a repro missing jq in `if true; then jq .; fi` is its own error. Found by the SP-3rzxx3m4 review.
